title: Schedule of Spend Reductions on Made-to-Order Deposit Percentages — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
The customer's spend takes percentage points off the made-to-order deposit percentage of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation, before that percentage is applied to the price. Spend is the total of the payments captured on the customer's Marlowe & Finch orders, the Online Orders on the profile. The window it is measured over depends on the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership.

| Customer's spend | Percentage points off |
|---|---|
| $3000 or more | 5 |
| $1500 up to less than $3000 | 2 |
| Less than $1500 | 0 |

**Band edges**

| Spend | Points off |
|---|---|
| $1499.99 | 0 |
| $1500.00 | 2 |
| $2999.99 | 2 |
| $3000.00 | 5 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A made-to-order deposit percentage of 50 with a spend of $3200.00 becomes 45 before it is applied to the price.
